jobs.name: S6-c
jobs.qa_notes: No people. Strictly side-on, cab left, blank cream box, flat cream hubs, both wheels circular. Truck ~95% of width (target 85), rear wheel centre ~(64.6%, 58%) vs target (59%, 42%), wheel dia ~26.3% W (~284 px at 1080; in the 270-330 spec). Too low by ~16% H: shift plate up ~300 px and extend the blurred paving at 0 cr, or accept for the dolly. Truck slightly simpler than OB-1 (no front bumper).

jobs.name: S6-d
jobs.qa_notes: No people (S4-a ref did not leak figures). Closer to OB-1 (bumper, mirror) and S4 city. Rear wheel ~20% W (~220 px, below 270), centre ~(76%, 66%): too small and low. Alternate.

jobs.name: S1-c
jobs.qa_notes: Lamp off, only cool phone glow + city bokeh, tired face, lips closed, no smile. Same layout and identity as S1-b, 7 blank-sticker parcels, no text.

jobs.name: S5-c
jobs.qa_notes: Warm golden lamp + morning window light (night bokeh gone), parcels gone, relaxed and smiling, same layout/identity. She is sharp rather than softly defocused: add defocus in post if wanted.

jobs.name: S2-test
jobs.model_config: kling3_0 pro 4s sound off 9:16, start_image S2-a 91914e32-702a-402f-b2d1-38582d0960fc
jobs.prompt: The courier, already holding the parcel with both hands, turns slowly to his right and walks out of frame to the right; the seller stays in the doorway and her smile grows softly, her hands stay still at her waist. Locked-off camera. The parcel keeps its shape and its blank round sticker; hands stay simple with no extra fingers; no morphing of faces or bodies. All surfaces stay blank: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
jobs.qa_notes: 1080x1912, 24 fps, 97 frames. Camera locked (0 px shift in static regions). Courier turns toward camera then walks right, out of frame ~2.9 s. Identities stable (beard, plain lime cap), 5-finger hands, box rigid, sticker blank (hidden ~1.25 s while box rotates, returns). Seller face stable, smile grows. No text, no morphing.
